leads.title: Zimbabwe Criminal Code - sodomy / unlawful sexual conduct provisions
leads.documents: Defines sodomy as anal sexual intercourse or any 'indecent act' between consenting adults; basis for criminalization of same-sex sexual activity.
leads.detail: Cited in article lead and Law section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: 2006 additions to Zimbabwe Criminal Code - 'sexual deviancy' law
leads.documents: Criminalized actions perceived as homosexual; article states it made it offense for two people of same sex to hold hands, hug, or kiss; sodomy redefined as any 'act involving contact between two males that would be regarded by a reasonable person as an indecent act'. Described as 1 of 15 additions quietly passed in Parliament.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Laws passed in 2006'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Constitution of Zimbabwe (2013 as amended) - marriage definition and Article 52
leads.documents: Bans same-sex marriage by defining marriage as between a man and a woman; Article 52 Right to personal security cited for intersex rights context: bodily integrity, freedom from violence, reproductive decisions, informed consent for medical experiments.
leads.detail: Cited as 'In 2013, the Zimbabwe Constitution was amended'; May 2019 Cabinet amendments to align marriage law; no URL visible

leads.title: Censorship and Entertainments Control Act, Section 11
leads.documents: Prohibits import, print, publish, distribute or keep for sale any undesirable publication defined as 'indecent or obscene or is offensive or harmful to public morals'; article says used to harass LGBTQ people and activists.
leads.detail: Citation detail visible: 'Section 11'; no URL visible

leads.title: Births and Deaths Registration Act, Section 18(2)
leads.documents: Gender marker change not allowed; allows change of first name by application to Registrar General with evidence; discretion may prevent name change based on gender identity; cited with activist Jordan Chanetsa comment on difficulty for transgender people to access legal work.
leads.detail: Citation detail visible: 'Section 18(2)'; no URL visible

leads.title: Freedom of Information Act (2020) and Cyber and Data Protection Act (2022)
leads.documents: Offer explicit protection based on sexual orientation regarding personal information - noted as limited discrimination protections.
leads.detail: Cited by Act name and year; no URL visible

leads.title: Zimbabwe Ministry of Health - training manuals for key populations
leads.documents: Adopted July [context 2018] manuals to educate health providers to cater to sex workers, men who have sex with men, transgender and non-gender conforming people and people who inject drugs; acknowledges illegality creates barriers undermining HIV prevention and access to healthcare; plus announcement of five health centres in Harare, Bulawayo, Gweru, Mutare and Kwekwe.
leads.detail: Direct quote from manuals visible in text; no URL visible

leads.title: Rikki Nathanson / Trans Research, Education, Advocacy & Training (TREAT) - 2014 criminal nuisance arrest and civil damages case
leads.documents: Documented trans-specific enforcement incident: Nathanson arrested in 2014 for using women's bathroom under criminal nuisance charge; charge thrown out; subsequent lawsuit for damages won. TREAT founded 2015.
leads.detail: Cited by name, year, charge; no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit - William Kimumwe asylum case (2005)
leads.documents: Documents enforcement narrative: gay man facing sodomy charges fled Zimbabwe 1998 for Kenya, US asylum denied, Eighth Circuit upheld denial in 2005 with majority holding experiences resulted from criminal status since homosexuality illegal, not persecution for orientation.
leads.detail: Citation detail visible: Eighth Circuit, Missouri, 2005, two-judge majority; no URL visible
